purpose: Known-input/known-output pairs for the authorization-matrix signing protocol. Both the offline signer and the Android verifier must produce byte-identical canonical bytes, digests, and signatures for every vector.

signed_object_shape.description: The signed unit is the wrapper, not the inner matrix. The domain field provides domain separation.
signed_object_shape.digest: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical bytes of the wrapper
signed_object_shape.signature: Ed25519 over the 32-byte digest (standard Ed25519, NOT Ed25519ph)

generation_procedure.step_1: For each vector, take the input_wrapper object.
generation_procedure.step_2: Canonicalize with RFC 8785 JCS. Result is UTF-8 bytes; store as a string in expected_canonical_bytes_utf8.
generation_procedure.step_3: Compute SHA-256 of those bytes. Store as lowercase hex in expected_sha256_digest_hex.
generation_procedure.step_4: Sign the 32-byte digest with the test-only Ed25519 private key. Store the 64-byte signature as base64url without padding in expected_ed25519_signature_base64url.
generation_procedure.step_5: Store the corresponding public key as base64url without padding in expected_provisioning_public_key_base64url.
generation_procedure.step_6: Run the procedure from the TypeScript reference implementation (backend) AND the Kotlin verifier. Both must produce byte-identical values for every field.
generation_procedure.step_7: Set generated: true and record generated_at.
generation_procedure.reference_implementation: backend/src/crypto/jcs.ts (to be written in Session A, TASK-P1-026)

test_only_key_derivation.description: The test-only Ed25519 key MUST NOT be committed. Derive it deterministically inside the test harness from a fixed seed.
test_only_key_derivation.derivation: HKDF-SHA256(seed, info='ed25519-test-key', length=32) => Ed25519 private key seed
test_only_key_derivation.warning: This key exists only to make vectors reproducible. It has no security value. It must never be used to sign a real matrix. It must never appear in a production build artifact.

rfc8785_reference.description: RFC 8785's own published test vectors exercise the canonicalizer against number formatting, Unicode escaping, and key ordering. They MUST be included verbatim in this file for canonicalizer-correctness coverage, independent of the Umoja wrapper vectors below.
rfc8785_reference.source: RFC 8785, Appendix (JSON Canonicalization Scheme Test Data)
rfc8785_reference.note: Do not hand-author RFC 8785 vectors. Import them verbatim from the published RFC. Any discrepancy between this file and the RFC is a bug in this file.

vectors.description: Baseline. Minimal valid wrapper with one device, one contact.
vectors.notes: Keys are illustrative placeholders. Real vectors use valid base64url 32-byte key material.

vectors.description: Key ordering. Input object keys are in non-canonical order; JCS sorts them by UTF-16 code unit.
vectors.notes: Must canonicalize to byte-identical output as W-001. This is the key-ordering test.

vectors.description: Array order significance. permitted_contacts array order is preserved, NOT sorted, because JSON arrays are ordered.
vectors.notes: Must NOT canonicalize to the same bytes as W-001 even if W-001's array were sorted. Array order is significant.

vectors.description: Number formatting. version given as 1.0 (float) must canonicalize identically to 1 (integer) under ES Number.prototype.toString.
vectors.notes: Must canonicalize to byte-identical output as W-001. This is the number-formatting test that Build Master §3.8 warns about.

vectors.description: Unicode string handling. Non-ASCII in clearance must serialize per ES string rules with no unnecessary escapes.
vectors.notes: The input uses \u escapes; the canonical output must use raw UTF-8 for printable characters.

vectors.description: Domain separation. A signature computed over the inner matrix alone (without the wrapper) MUST fail verification against this vector.
vectors.must_fail_when_canonicalizing: the inner matrix alone (without the domain wrapper)
vectors.notes: TEST-MATRIX-010 sharp edge. This vector is the one that proves the wrapper is load-bearing. If signing the inner matrix alone still verifies, the wrapper is not being enforced and the implementation is wrong.

vectors.description: Duplicate keys in input must be rejected before canonicalization.
vectors.notes: Build Master §3.8: 'No duplicate keys allowed; if duplicate keys are detected, the matrix is invalid.' The exact detection point is implementation-defined, but the matrix must not be accepted.

vectors.description: Missing domain field must be rejected.
vectors.notes: The signed unit is the wrapper. A wrapper without a domain is not the signed object.

vectors.description: Wrong domain value must be rejected.
vectors.notes: Domain separation only works if the domain value is exactly 'umoja.authorization-matrix.v1'.

acceptance_criteria.interop: For every positive vector, the TypeScript reference implementation and the Kotlin verifier MUST produce byte-identical values for: expected_canonical_bytes_utf8, expected_sha256_digest_hex, expected_ed25519_signature_base64url.
acceptance_criteria.negative: For every negative vector, both implementations MUST reject.
acceptance_criteria.not_sufficient_to_match_final_verificati: Matching final verification results is NOT sufficient. Both implementations must produce identical intermediate values (canonical bytes, digest, signature). This is stated in Build Master §3.8 and is the core requirement of TASK-P1-026.
acceptance_criteria.wrapper_load_bearing: TEST-MATRIX-010: the W-006 negative assertion must pass. Signing the inner matrix alone must fail verification.

revision_history.change: Initial scaffold. Vectors authored; outputs null pending Session A generation.

stop_condition: This file is NOT authoritative until generated: true. Until then, no signing code may be committed. Build Master §3.8 makes vectors a precondition for the matrix signing protocol, and §11 prohibits accepting a matrix that has not been canonicalized per RFC 8785.
